name: fst'_self_eq_snd
statement: P ≤ MorphismProperty.monomorphisms C) {X : C} {f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ G} (hf : P.presheaf f) : hf.rep.fst' f = hf.rep.snd f

name: isIso_fst'_self
statement: P ≤ MorphismProperty.monomorphisms C) {X : C} {f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ G} (hf : P.presheaf f) : IsIso (hf.rep.fst' f)
